title: Choose psimeter's visual world
question: The roll landed on the Brass Aneroid. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Comps show the systemSmall widget with live NEA PSI from 14 Oct, 20:30 SGT; AQI figures are placeholders until the WAQI token is in.

options.label: Brass Aneroid
options.lineage: Ship's aneroid barometers and precision instrument dials
options.thesis: Air read off a real instrument: the needle gives the band at a glance, a roller counter gives the exact figure.
options.viewport: One round dial fills the square. The PSI needle sweeps an enamelled five-band arc, the exact PSI rolls in a counter window, and AQI sits on its own sub-dial at six o'clock.
options.risk: The literal reading of 'meter'. Rendered timidly it becomes clip-art, and two scales on one 170pt face can crowd.

raised.raise: Colour is state only: the enamel arc is the face's only colour, and just the current band's segment runs at full saturation.
Every graduation is drawn in code at one device pixel per widget size. The metal is raster; the scale is vector and never blurs.
Night is a material change: in dark mode the dial turns black lacquer and the numerals glow in radium lume, not an inverted palette.
The bezel is the island: the N, S, E, W regional PSIs are engraved at their compass points, so the map and the scale are one space.

options.label: Changi Flap Board
options.lineage: Solari split-flap departure boards at Changi T1 and T2
options.thesis: The day's air posted like a departure: exact figures on mechanical flaps, read the way Singapore reads a gate.
options.viewport: Two flap rows, PSI 183 and AQI 168, each with a status flap (UNHEALTHY) and a small source and time flap beneath.
options.risk: Familiar: split-flap is a well-worn widget look, it shares Changi ground with the boarding-pass card, and WidgetKit can't animate the flip on the Home Screen.

options.label: Boarding Pass Stub
options.lineage: Segmented airline boarding pass and live gate board
options.thesis: Each reading is a printed pass segment: labelled boxes, tabular figures, and one alert colour that holds when the band changes.
options.viewport: A pass stub filling the tile: PSI 183 and AQI 168 in two labelled segments (SOURCE, WINDOW, STATUS), torn edge on the right.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and wins clarity, since labelled segments carry two sources perfectly. It only ties on audience: Changi is beloved, but a ticket isn't an air instrument.
options.risk: Reads as a travel-app costume if the paper and print aren't physically convincing.

options.label: Haze Exposure Sheet
options.lineage: Darkroom exposure record over a backlit zone-system wedge
options.thesis: Haze is optical density: the reading sits on a backlit eleven-step grey wedge, the matching step glowing through translucent film.
options.viewport: A taped translucent card over a vertical eleven-step wedge. PSI and AQI sit as tabular figures in ruled boxes; each reading's wedge step is lit.
options.case: Fuses well and holds clarity: haze literally is density, and ruled boxes carry exact numbers. Loses audience, since few people know darkroom craft.
options.risk: Can read as a photographer's in-joke, and a greyscale scale makes the band word carry all the meaning.

options.label: Graphite Console
options.thesis: Graphite panels split by hairline seams, accents reserved for state.
options.viewport: Two graphite panels with mono figures.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a flat console contradicts the skeuomorphic brief, and nobody checks the haze in a terminal.
options.risk: Flat by design; fails the brief.

options.label: Ruled Reference Page
options.lineage: Wide-margin reference edition drawn by a ruling engine
options.thesis: Twin text columns around a vermilion key rail.
options.viewport: Two dense columns with a centre rail.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dense columns can't be read in a one-second glance.
options.kept: Hairlines drawn by code at one device pixel.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Readings as magnitude dots on a navy chart.
options.viewport: Dots sized by reading on a navy plate.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dot size trades exact numbers for relative magnitude.
options.kept: Night treated as a real material change.

options.label: Convention Catalog
options.lineage: Doujin event circle catalog on newsprint
options.thesis: Stamp-sized cells keyed to a hall map.
options.viewport: A packed grid of tiny cells.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a dense cell grid buries two readings.
options.kept: The map and the scale share one space.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What air-quality widgets ship: a big number on a band-coloured tile, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Huge PSI on an orange tile, band word beneath, AQI and update time in a footer row.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from IQAir and every weather app, and not skeuomorphic at all.
